children.name: Long Game
children.description:
Our walk with God is not based on one day or one experience, but instead the process that God has in store for us. When we put our trust in Him, we can hold onto His promises through every win and loss in life.

Our faith in God is a long game.

children.name: No Greater Love
children.description: In this mini-series, we confront the myths and discover what God says about real love - His love.

children.name: Original
children.description:
When God created us, He made us an original. 

In this mini-series "ORIGINAL", we will look at the biblical principles we can use to embrace our God-given purpose. As John Mason says, "You're born an original, don't die a copy."

children.name: Drift
children.description: It can be easy to drift away from what truly matters in life. Small choices or compromises that seem insignificant can slowly take us off the course God has laid out for our lives. In this mini-series, we address those small incremental changes and how we can stay aligned with the purpose God has for us.

children.name: Bad Theology
children.description: The enemy likes to plant lies about God’s character that distort our beliefs about Him. In this series, we expose these lies and replace them with biblical truth, helping us rediscover God’s true nature and deepen our relationship with Him.

children.name: Sidetracked
children.description: Life is full of distractions. What choice will we make? Will we be sidetracked or live with the purpose we were created for?

children.name: It's Not Too Late
children.description: Have you ever thought, "I've sinned too much for God to forgive me"? Keep fighting! There are way too many people that give up on life because they think they are too far gone.

children.name: Rescued
children.description: Help is on the way! There is hope for your situation, no matter how impossible it may seem.

children.name: Don't Panic
children.description: Panic and anxiety has become increasingly prevalent in our fast-paced and demanding world. No matter what you're facing, you don't have to live with crippling panic and anxiety. Don't lose hope!

children.name: Brown Grass
children.description: Stop looking at other places as the answer to a better life. It's time we stop treating the symptoms and start addressing the root problem.

children.name: It's All A Setup
children.description: Trust in God that what you see as a SETBACK, is actually a SETUP for greater things!

children.name: Speed Trap
children.description: Oftentimes the busyness of life can leave us burnt out. It’s important to take a step back, rest, and get out of the cycle of being caught in a speed trap.

children.name: Life's Questions
children.description: Though we may not have all the answers, the Word of God gives us comfort and peace when we do not know the answer to “WHY?”.

children.name: No Shortcuts
children.description: Shortcuts in life seem like a good decision in the moment. But soon, we realize that shortcuts cause us to miss the plan God has for us.

children.name: Gratitude
children.description: It can be easy to look at what others have and not be grateful for the things we've been blessed with. But when we learn to find thankfulness in what we do have, that's when we can experience the peace and power of gratitude.

category.name: Faith Stories
category.description: Our Faith Stories are all about lives changed by the power and love of Christ. No matter your story, FAITH can be your place of hope!
